overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission reviewed multiple one-day license applications, an outdoor seating request, and a package store license transfer, while also hearing an update on youth drinking prevention efforts. All requested licenses and alterations were approved subject to standard administrative requirements.

items.title: One-Day License: Event Them Studios
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for Event Them Studios to host a live art show at 344 Salem Street on June 20, 2023, contingent on providing proof of insurance.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Riverside Plaza Summer Series Concerts
items.summary: Approved four one-day beer and wine licenses for the Medford Recreation Department's summer concert series at Riverside Plaza on June 2, June 9, June 16, and June 23, 2023.

items.title: Alteration of Premises: Oasis Brazilian Restaurant
items.summary: Approved an application for alteration of premises to permit outdoor patio seating at Oasis Brazilian Restaurant at 373 Main Street, subject to approval from other city review departments.

items.title: License Transfer: Medford Cappies Inc.
items.summary: Approved the transfer of the package store license at 10 Revere Beach Parkway to Medford Cappies Inc., designating Veral Patel as the manager of record.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: West Medford Community Center
items.summary: Approved two one-day liquor licenses for West Medford Community Center fundraising events on May 26 and May 27, 2023, with alcohol service limited to 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. and subject to insurance and layout diagram submittals.

items.title: Youth Substance Use Prevention and Compliance Check Update
items.summary: Prevention Outreach Manager Penelope Funaiole updated the commission on plans to reinstate alcohol compliance checks three to four times annually and offer regional TIPS alcohol server training.
